description: A complete HTML page implementing a web-based database visualizer interface, including CSS styles, structure, and JavaScript for fetching and displaying database and table data dynamically.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the server and renders the database list in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list, resets selected database and table, and updates the UI accordingly.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the list of tables for a selected database, and loads tables when expanded.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches tables for a database and renders them in the sidebar under the database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches data for a selected table and renders the data table in the main content area.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML for a data table from the data array.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates a table cell based on the data type and length, with clickable behavior for large or object content.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content to show full or truncated data.
